nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: DEACTIVATED. Internal-call (INTERNAL_EMAIL_SECRET — system-level, not session). Write-tool MCP gateway — extends the existing read-only clx-mcp-tool-gateway with the action tools the AI Agent needs. Each tool wraps an underlying workflow. Logs every invocation to mcp_tool_calls. Claude (in C1 decision engine, future) can call this with { tool_name, tool_input } to take real actions: place_outbound_call, send_whatsapp, send_sms, send_email, generate_video, book_meeting, update_lead_status, log_decision, retrieve_lead_memory, escalate_to_human.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ internal_secret: $env.INTERNAL_EMAIL_SECRET, decision_id: ($json.correlation_id || $json.tool_input.decision_id || null), action_type: $json.executor_action_type, client_id: $json.client_id, lead_id: ($json.tool_input.lead_id || null), channel: ($json.tool_input.channel || null), message: ($json.tool_input.message || ''), approval: ($json.tool_input.approval || null), agent_id: $json.agent_id, via: 'mcp' }) }}
